propositions: Plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable even when a prerequisite ticket declares it will create them, because only the origin/main snapshot is consulted and depends_on edges are not honored.

A plan citing a relied-upon symbol with [rebar:<id>] syntax should have that citation verified against both directions of the dependency edge (plan declares depends_on, or cited ticket declares blocks), and Layer-1 advisory parsing must catch edge-unbacked citations without blocking.

Layer-2 LLM grounding must retrieve the cited ticket via show_ticket, affirmatively confirm its plan/file_impact covers the specific missing functionality, and credit the citation only if both the edge is verified and coverage is confirmed (fail-closed otherwise).
Error handling in reverse-lookup via resolve_deps must be fail-closed: any exception is caught, the citation treated as unverified, and no exception propagates into the advisory lane.

Rubric prose in G1G2/E4/E6 must specify the Layer-2 show_ticket coverage protocol (trigger, procedure, inputs, decision) and explicitly document that uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations remain subject to normal missing-symbol blocks.
